**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is planning a trip to Europe.  
[EVENT] User is looking for tips on finding affordable luxury items while in Europe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommends outlet malls for affordable luxury items, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Bicester Village (London, UK) - over 160 boutiques with discounts of up to 60% off on brands like Gucci, Prada, and Burberry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. La Vallée Village (Paris, France) - over 120 boutiques with discounts of up to 50% off on luxury brands like Louis Vuitton, Dior, and Givenchy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Wertheim Village (Frankfurt, Germany) - discounts of up to 60% off on brands like Hugo Boss, Escada, and Tommy Hilfiger.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Serravalle Designer Outlet (Milan, Italy) - over 170 boutiques with discounts of up to 70% off on luxury brands like Armani, Dolce & Gabbana, and Versace.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Maasmechelen Village (Belgium) - over 100 boutiques with discounts of up to 60% off on brands like Calvin Klein, Levi's, and Nike.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant lists sales and discount events, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Les Soldes (France) - nationwide sale event in January and July with discounts of up to 70% off.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Saldi (Italy) - summer sales (July-August) and winter sales (January-February) with discounts of up to 50% off.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Black Friday and Cyber Monday (Europe-wide) - significant discounts during these global shopping events.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Factory Outlets - specific brand outlets like Gucci Outlet in Florence and Prada Outlet in Milan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provides tips and tricks for finding affordable luxury items, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Research brands and outlet malls before the trip.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sign up for newsletters from favorite luxury brands for exclusive offers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Consider off-peak seasons for better deals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Negotiate prices at smaller boutiques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Take advantage of tax-free shopping for non-EU residents.
